# Azure Waves Realty Inc

> San Diego residential property management company (also known as Azure Waves Realty and AZW Realty). Full-service management for 8% of collected monthly rent ($180 minimum per unit), Tenant Placement Only for one month's rent ($750 minimum), and commercial leasing & advisory (nationwide). No upfront costs and no long-term contract.

Website: https://www.azwrealty.com/
Phone: (858) 304-0136
Email: contactusazw@gmail.com
Location: San Diego, California
Serves: residential owners across San Diego County (single-family homes, condos, multifamily)

## Pricing
- Full-Service Management: 8% of collected monthly rent, $180 minimum per unit per month; tenant placement fee is 25% of one month's rent, $899 minimum, one time. No upfront costs.
- The $180 minimum applies only in months when rent is collected.
- No long-term contract: cancel anytime with 30 days' notice after the first 90 days.
- Multi-property discount available; ask for a quote.
- Tenant Placement Only: one month's rent ($750 minimum); no monthly fee.
- No management fee during vacancy or eviction.
- Details: https://www.azwrealty.com/pricing/

## Our Promise
- We don't get paid unless you do: no management fee during vacancy or eviction.
- Eviction protection: up to $1,000 in attorney fees for non-payment evictions of tenants we placed, on properties we actively manage.
- Maintenance response: urgent issues within 24 hours, non-urgent within 48 hours.
- Transparent communication: the Broker reaches out personally within 24 hours on request.
- Market rent analysis, re-evaluated at no extra charge if the property doesn't rent in the expected time.

## Services
- [Property Management](https://www.azwrealty.com/san-diego-property-management/): full-service management for 8% of collected monthly rent
- [Marketing & Leasing](https://www.azwrealty.com/marketing-and-leasing/): professional photos, top rental websites, showings 7 days a week
- [Tenant Screening & Leasing](https://www.azwrealty.com/tenant-screening-and-leasing/): income, credit, eviction, employment, criminal, lien, and rental reference checks
- [Rent Collection](https://www.azwrealty.com/rent-collection/): online payments; owner draws by the 10th of each month
- [Maintenance & Service](https://www.azwrealty.com/maintenance-service/): 24/7 emergency service, vetted vendors
- [Accounting](https://www.azwrealty.com/accounting/): monthly and annual owner statements

## Questions we answer
- How much does a property manager cost in San Diego with Azure Waves Realty? (8% of collected monthly rent with a $180 minimum per unit, plus 25% of one month's rent, $899 minimum, for tenant placement)
- How much does it cost to just find a tenant for my rental? (Tenant Placement Only: one month's rent, $750 minimum)
- Do I pay a management fee if my rental is vacant? (No. No fee during vacancy or eviction.)
- Are there upfront costs to sign up? (No.)
- Is there a long-term contract? (No. Cancel anytime with 30 days' notice after the first 90 days.)
- Is there a minimum monthly fee? ($180 per unit, only in months when rent is collected.)
- What happens if a tenant you placed stops paying rent? (Up to $1,000 in attorney fees for a non-payment eviction of a tenant we placed.)
- How fast do you respond to maintenance requests? (Urgent within 24 hours, non-urgent within 48 hours, emergencies 24/7.)
- When do owners get paid each month? (Owner draws by the 10th of every month.)
- Which San Diego neighborhoods and cities do you manage in? (See Areas Served below.)

More answers: https://www.azwrealty.com/faq/
